purpose: How much of the last dive's stroll is the Suit's? Your winning kit, Suit 3 — first of a pair; suit-off is the same dive without it.
play: One whole dive, top to win or death, played as you would play your last dive. Don't press R. Then play 2026-10-28-suit-off.
measures: hits a gate, and how many the guard took
HP after each gate; the lowest HP of the dive
time a gate and a layer; the bosses' times
dashes and shots a gate: how much the guard lets you stand and swing
compared gate by gate with suit-off: same seed, same batches
